# omadafusion_port_forwarding (Resource)

A NAT port-forwarding (virtual server) rule on the gateway. Names must be unique. Prefer `source_cidrs` to limit who can reach a forwarded port.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_wan_ports" "this" {}

locals {
  wan1 = one([for p in data.omadafusion_wan_ports.this.ports : p.id if p.name == "WAN1"])
}

# Forward WireGuard to an internal VPN host, only from one partner network.
resource "omadafusion_port_forwarding" "wireguard" {
  name          = "WireGuard"
  wan_port_ids  = [local.wan1]
  source_cidrs  = ["198.51.100.0/24"]
  external_port = "51820"
  forward_ip    = "192.168.10.20"
  forward_port  = "51820"
  protocol      = "udp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_port` (String) Public port or range, e.g. `51820` or `8000-8010`.
- `forward_ip` (String) LAN address to forward to.
- `forward_port` (String) LAN port or range.
- `name` (String) Rule name. Must be unique.
- `wan_port_ids` (List of String) WAN port UUIDs, e.g. from `data.omadafusion_wan_ports`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `protocol` (String) `all`, `tcp` or `udp`.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `source_cidrs` (List of String) Only allow these source networks (`from = limited`). Omit to allow any source.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_port_forwarding.wireguard Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000001
```
